Ameritas Investment Partners Increased Its Kennametal (KMT) Stake by $1.12 Million; Manchester Capital Management Stake in Grainger W W (GWW) Lifted as Stock Price Rose
May 20, 2018 - By Jacob Smith
Manchester Capital Management Llc increased its stake in Grainger W W Inc (GWW) by 1097.56% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Manchester Capital Management Llc bought 1,800 shares as the company’s stock rose 16.26% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 1,964 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $464,000, up from 164 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Manchester Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Grainger W W Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $17.23 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.26% or $0.81 during the last trading session, reaching $307.61. About 708,715 shares traded. W.W. Grainger, Inc. (NYSE:GWW) has risen 15.02% since May 20, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 3.47% the S&P500.
Ameritas Investment Partners Inc increased its stake in Kennametal Inc (KMT) by 74.78% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Ameritas Investment Partners Inc bought 23,300 shares as the company’s stock declined 16.35% with the market. The institutional investor held 54,457 shares of the industrial machinery and components company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.64M, up from 31,157 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Ameritas Investment Partners Inc who had been investing in Kennametal Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $3.24 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.23% or $0.09 during the last trading session, reaching $39.64. About 545,861 shares traded. Kennametal Inc. (NYSE:KMT) has risen 10.68% since May 20, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 0.87% the S&P500.
Since December 13, 2017, it had 0 insider buys, and 1 insider sale for $960,000 activity.
Ameritas Investment Partners Inc, which manages about $2.19B US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in At&T Inc (NYSE:T) by 11,523 shares to 210,871 shares, valued at $7.51 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Ishares Tr (IWM) by 6,869 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 156,740 shares, and cut its stake in Schlumberger Ltd (NYSE:SLB).
